top_signals.title: AI Scare Threatens Fund Flows Beating Rest of Market 13-to-1
top_signals.summary: For months, AI-obsessed investors have thrown billions of dollars into technology stocks and largely ignored the rest of the stock market. Monday’s rout in the sector following calls by industry leaders to temped the pace of development in the technology was a reminder of the case for diversification.
